awards.name: COMMENTS: Obviously too few for top UCs. As it is "advanced public speaking and business" are not exactly rigorous.

SERVICE_CONTEXT.service_summary: I'm worried about my senior year schedule and want some advice on whether I should take another class. I'm enrolled in 6 classes this semester, including 3 APs, 1 dual community college course, and 2 electives (advanced public speaking and business). For next semester, I'm dropping speech and debate (adv. pub spk) and my community college class ends so I'll only have 4 classes. Is that too few?
